title: Alamomin Dollar, IF da mai bin diddigi wanda ya gaya muku gaskiya
course_title: Excel da Google Sheets don Ƙananan Kasuwanci

say: Alamun Dollar, IF, da kuma mai bin diddigi wanda ke gaya muku gaskiya.
Wannan bidiyon ne don Module 2 na Excel da Google Sheets don Ƙananan Kasuwanci.
A cikin wannan tsarin za ku koyi kwafi dabara ba tare da karya ta ba, sannan ku gina takarda guda ɗaya wanda ke rubuta kowane siyarwa da kowane kuɗi.

panel.heading: Abin da za ku iya yi
items: Kwafi dabarun ba tare da karya su ba
Bibiyar kowane tallace-tallace da kashe kuɗi a cikin takarda ɗaya
Duba kuɗi a ciki, fitar da kuɗi da ma'aunin ku
Nemo ku gyara kurakurai masu ƙarfi da shiru

say: Yana gaya muku abin da ya shigo, abin da ya fita, da abin da ya rage. Kuma kuna koyon kama kurakurai waɗanda ke yin daidai daidai.

say: Lokacin da kuka kwafi = C2*D2 ƙasa, zai zama = C3*D3 a jere na gaba. Wannan magana ce ta dangi. Yana zamewa tare da jere, kuma mafi yawan lokaci shine ainihin abin da kuke so.

panel.heading: Dangi ko cikakkiya?
left: Yana motsawa lokacin da aka kwafi

say: Amma wani lokacin kowane layi dole ne ya yi amfani da tantanin halitta iri ɗaya, kamar adadin kwamitocin da aka buga a sama.
Sannan ku kulle ta da alamun dala: $H$1. A nan alamar dala ba ta da alaƙa da kuɗi. Yana nufin kar a motsa.
A waya, rubuta alamun dala da kanka. A kan kwamfutar Windows, danna F4.

panel.heading: Dangi ko cikakkiya?
left: Yana motsawa lokacin da aka kwafi

say: Ga misalin aiki. Kemi ta rubuta mata kashi 5% sau ɗaya, a cikin cell H1, kuma adadin tallace-tallacenta a shafi na E.

card.title: Hukumar tallace-tallace ta Kemi
card.note: Jimlar hukumar shine daidai kashi 5% na jimlar tallace-tallace.

say: Da farko ta rubuta = E2*H1 kuma ta kwafi shi ƙasa. Layi na gaba ya zama sau E3 H2. Amma H2 fanko ne, don haka kowane jere bayan na farko yana nuna 0. Wannan shine kuskuren gama gari.

say: Bisi yana rikodin kwanaki 4 na tallace-tallace da farashi. A rana ta 1 ta sayar da faranti 25, sannan ta sayi kayan abinci akan 55000. Ma'auni nata ba ya da kyau, ya rage 17500.
Wannan gargadin kuɗaɗe ne mai amfani. Babban sayayya ta zo kafin tallace-tallacen da suka biya.
A karshe, kudi a cikin Naira 157500 kuma kudin da aka fitar ya kai 73500.

say: Kowane mai amfani da maƙunsar rubutu yana yin kuskure. Kurakurai masu ƙarfi suna nuna lamba. Hash DIV slash 0 yana nufin ka raba ta sifili ko tantanin halitta mara komai.

panel.heading: Kurakurai masu ƙarfi da abin da suke nufi

cards.d: Rarraba ta sifili ko ta tantanin halitta mara komai. Cika tantanin halitta, ko amfani da IFERROR don gibin da ake tsammani.
Lissafi akan abin da ba lamba ba, kamar N2000. Sake buga shi azaman fili lamba.
Ƙididdigar tana nuna tantanin halitta da kuka goge. Gyara kai tsaye, ko mayar da tarihin sigar.

card.title: Jimlar Chioma ya yi ƙasa da ƙasa
card.note: COUNT ƙasa da COUNTA yana nufin adadin rubutu.

say: SUM ta Chioma ta ce 61000, amma lissafinta ya ce 66000.
COUNT akan ginshiƙi ya ba 4, amma COUNTA ya ba da 5. Don haka tantanin halitta ɗaya shine rubutu.

rows: Bace: B4 da aka buga a matsayin N5,000

say: Don tunawa. Alamomin dollar sun kulle tantanin halitta daya. IDAN ya yanke shawara: gwaji, ƙima idan gaskiya ne, ƙima idan ƙarya.
Ma'auni yana ƙarawa kuma yana raguwa a layi-layi. Kuɗin da ya rage bai ci riba ba tukuna. Kuma idan COUNT ya fi COUNTA, farautar adadin da aka buga azaman rubutu.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: $H$1 yana kulle tantanin halitta ɗaya lokacin da kuka kwafi
IDAN: Gwaji, ƙima idan gaskiya ne, ƙima idan ƙarya
Ma'auni: jere a sama, da ciki, cire waje
Kuɗin da ya rage bai kai riba ba tukuna
Idan COUNT bai kai COUNTA ba, nemo rubutun

say: Yanzu juzu'in ku. Yi amfani da ƙima ɗaya a cikin layuka da yawa, gina naku tracker tare da aƙalla ma'amaloli 8, sannan ku yi farautar kuskure.
Ƙara tantanin dubawa wanda ya ce Daidaita lokacin da jimlar ku ta yarda. Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Kudi ɗaya, layuka da yawa
